Friendzy / Classic party games / The Silent Game

How to play The Silent Game

Communicate everything. Say nothing. Absolute silence. No talking, no mouthing words. Everything must be communicated through gestures, expressions, and props. Set a challenge and see who can complete it first.

2–10 players~10 minFocused & HilariousActing & performance games

How to play

  1. No talking allowed — not even whispering.
  2. Choose a challenge: tell a story, order food, explain a problem, give directions.
  3. Players must communicate only through body language and gestures.
  4. Optional: one player can write on paper, others cannot.
  5. Group judges who communicated most effectively.

Example round

  • Challenge: tell the group what you had for lunch. Watch someone dramatically mime eating a salad with great regret.
  • Challenge: explain why you were late. A full silent drama unfolds.
  • Challenge: two people have a silent argument. Somehow feels more intense than a real one.

Tips

  • Agree on a 'reset' signal (like a time-out hand gesture) in case of total confusion.
  • Great challenge: plan a silent heist together, then act out the heist.
